name: Trustbadg – Trust Badges, Payment Icons & Secure Checkout Seals
author: ashiquzzaman

sections.description:
Trustbadg is the ultimate WordPress trust badge and payment icon plugin designed specifically for the modern Gutenberg block editor. Whether you run a WooCommerce store, sell digital downloads with Easy Digital Downloads, or operate a membership site, Trustbadg helps you display professional trust seals, payment method icons, and secure checkout badges exactly where shoppers need reassurance most.

Stop wrestling with clunky HTML snippets, rigid theme widgets, or expensive third-party SaaS badge platforms that lock your checkout styling behind recurring monthly subscriptions. With Trustbadg, every badge set lives securely on your own WordPress site as a native custom post type, giving you absolute control over your store branding, icon selection, design styling, and automatic placement rules.

Built for Conversions, Designed for Speed: Trustbadg features a professionally structured badge set editor with live preview, semantic server-rendered HTML, and inline SVG icons. Unlike image-heavy badge widgets that slow checkout pages or break on mobile, Trustbadg outputs clean, cache-friendly markup with zero frontend JavaScript. So payment icons and security seals load instantly and look polished across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Why Choose a WordPress-Based Trust Badge Solution?

  • Own Your Store Branding: Keep every badge set, icon mix, design preset, and placement rule in your WordPress database. No third-party data collection, proprietary editor lock-in, or sudden subscription price hikes.
  • Instant Block & Shortcode Placement: Insert the Trustbadg block anywhere in Gutenberg or copy a generated shortcode into pages, posts, widgets, or theme templates with live editor preview before you publish.
  • Native Gutenberg Experience: Build badge sets using a familiar tabbed editor inside WordPress. No complex external page builders or custom code snippets required.
  • Automatic E-Commerce Placements: Show badges on product pages, cart, checkout, shop archives, and supported plugin contexts without manually editing theme files.
  • Seamless Theme Integration: Server-rendered HTML and conditional CSS loading keep badge output lightweight and compatible with full-page caching plugins and WooCommerce HPOS.

How It Works

  1. Create a Badge Set: Open Trustbadg → Badge Sets and add a new badge set with a name and optional heading or supporting text.
  2. Choose Icons & Design: Pick from bundled GPL icon presets or build a Custom Mix, then customize themes, layout styles, colors, spacing, and animations on the Design tab.
  3. Configure Placement: Use the block or shortcode anywhere, or enable automatic placements for site content and supported e-commerce plugins on the Placement tab.
  4. Publish & Convert: Hit publish to render trust badges on your storefront with inline SVG icons, no frontend JavaScript, and CSS that loads only where badges appear.

Designed for Every E-Commerce Workflow

  • For WooCommerce Stores: Display payment icons and secure checkout seals on product pages, cart, checkout, and category archives with optional per-product badge set overrides.
  • For Digital Download Sellers: Place trust badges on Easy Digital Downloads product and checkout pages to reassure buyers before purchase.
  • For Modern Checkout Plugins: Support SureCart and FluentCart placements, including instant buy URLs, without custom theme development.
  • For Membership & Donation Sites: Automatic placements for MemberPress, Restrict Content Pro, Paid Memberships Pro, and GiveWP when each plugin is active.
  • For Agencies & Developers: Spin up reusable badge sets for client stores using standard WordPress hooks, filters, and a REST-powered editor with no SaaS dashboard required.

Comprehensive Badge Set Builder

Build every part of your checkout trust experience with dedicated, flexible editor tabs:

  • Content > Icon Mix: Start from 3 bundled icon mix presets or switch to Custom Mix; search 501 GPL-compatible SVG icons across represented categories; drag to reorder and remove icons with tooltips.
  • Content > Messaging: Add an optional heading and supporting text to reinforce secure checkout, accepted payment methods, or satisfaction guarantees.
  • Design > Themes & Colors: Choose from 5 design themes plus Custom Color; customize background, accent, corner radius, padding, and margin; reset per-theme defaults with one click.
  • Design > Layout & Motion: Pick from 3 layout styles and 3 animation presets; control desktop and mobile icon sizes, icon alignment, and heading/text typography.
  • Design > Live Preview: Preview badge sets in the editor with desktop and mobile device views before publishing.
  • Placement > Automatic Rules: Enable grouped automatic placements for site content and active e-commerce plugins; filter by WooCommerce product categories and tags, specific pages, or custom URL paths.
  • Settings > Import & Privacy: Export and import badge set data; optionally retain all data when the plugin is uninstalled.

Why Store Owners Choose Trustbadg

  • Never Paste Raw HTML Again: Replace fragile theme snippets with reusable badge sets you can update once and display everywhere via block, shortcode, or automatic placement.
  • Target Multiple Storefront Contexts: Maintain distinct badge sets for checkout, product pages, cart, and landing pages each with its own icons, design, and placement rules.
  • Ship Faster From Your Dashboard: Publish badge sets with live preview, REST save, and copy-paste shortcodes & no tab-switching between SaaS dashboards and WordPress.
  • Zero Frontend Bloat: Render badges as server-side HTML with pure CSS. Bundled icons use inline SVG markup; public CSS loads only where badges are expected to appear.
  • Preview Exact Layouts Before Publishing: Eliminate guesswork with real-time editor preview, theme swatches, and mobile layout simulation on the Design tab.
  • Own Your Badge Data Forever: Keep 100% control of badge sets and settings on your own domain with no monthly SaaS fees, no platform export drama, and total data privacy.

Free vs. Trustbadg Pro Features

Free Version Features:

  • Unlimited reusable badge sets (custom post type)
  • 501 bundled GPL-compatible SVG icons (first manifest order) across represented categories
  • 3 icon mix presets plus Custom Mix
  • 5 design themes plus Custom Color
  • 3 layout styles and 3 animation presets
  • Gutenberg block and shortcode rendering with live editor preview
  • Automatic placements for site content and supported e-commerce plugins (WooCommerce, EDD, SureCart, FluentCart, MemberPress, RCP, PMPro, GiveWP)
  • Per-set placement filters: product categories/tags, specific pages, custom URL paths
  • Per-product WooCommerce badge set override
  • Settings import and export; retain data on uninstall option
  • Inline SVG icons on the frontend; conditional public CSS loading (no frontend JavaScript)

Trustbadg Pro Features:

  • Brand Module: Upload custom icons via the WordPress Media Library, unlock the full bundled 1001 icons.
  • Targeting Module: Access the Targeting & Rules tab with geo-targeted payment badges, conditional product rules (WooCommerce category/tag/SKU, EDD download categories, SureCart collections, FluentCart categories), EDD product override.
  • Full Design Library: Unlock all icon mix presets, design themes, layout styles, and animation presets beyond the free tier limits.

Supercharge Your Store Workflow with Trustbadg Pro

Free Trustbadg covers unlimited badge sets, block and shortcode placement, automatic e-commerce placements, and a strong starter icon and design library. Trustbadg Pro is built for stores that need faster iteration, sharper localization, and brand-perfect checkout reassurance without leaving WordPress.

  • Ship client-ready branding faster: Upload payment logos and custom seals from the Media Library, and tune per badge set. Ideal for agencies standardizing checkout trust across multiple sites.
  • Show the right payment icons to the right visitor: Geo-targeted payment badges use server-side country detection (Cloudflare or WooCommerce geolocation) so international shoppers see familiar methods at cart and checkout with no third-party geo API.
  • One badge set, many contexts: Use the Targeting & Rules tab to append icons when cart or product context matches WooCommerce categories, tags, or SKUs; EDD download categories; SureCart collections; or FluentCart categories with fewer duplicate badge sets to maintain.
  • Unlock the full creative toolkit: Access the complete bundled library (1000+ icons), all icon mix presets, 21 themes, 7 layout styles, and 23 animation presets for polished, on-brand trust rows on every device.
  • Upgrade without rebuilding: Replace the plugin files with the Pro ZIP, activate, and enter your license; existing badge sets, meta, and placements stay in your database. Enable Retain data on uninstall under Privacy before swapping files if you prefer an extra safety net.

Learn more and compare Personal, Professional, and Agency plans: Upgrade to Trust Badge Pro

More Notable Products From the Author

Trustbadg is developed by Asphalt Themes. If you build careers or personal brands on WordPress, these free products from the same author may help:

  • Rezicraft – Professional Resume & CV Builder – Create polished online resumes and CVs with Gutenberg-friendly layouts, sections for experience and skills, and templates aimed at job seekers and freelancers.
  • Resumee – A free WordPress resume and portfolio theme with SEO-friendly markup, flexible sections for education and achievements, and a clean one-column layout for professional online profiles.

Why Trustbadg vs. Third-Party Badge Widgets

While third-party trust badge SaaS platforms and hosted widgets have popularized checkout reassurance, they often come with hidden costs, restrictive lock-ins, and performance compromises. Trustbadg reimagines store trust signals by shifting control back to the site owner through a native WordPress solution.

  • Complete Data Ownership & Privacy
    Traditional badge platforms store your icon selections, placement rules, and styling on third-party cloud servers. With Trustbadg, your badge sets stay entirely on your own self-hosted WordPress installation with no external API calls, analytics, or visitor tracking in the free or Pro builds.
  • Zero Subscription Fatigue
    Most SaaS badge tools lock custom uploads, geo-targeting, or advanced placement behind recurring monthly or annual paywalls. Built directly for the WordPress ecosystem, Trustbadg gives you a capable free tier and an optional Pro upgrade without forcing every store into a SaaS dashboard.
  • Native Gutenberg Integration
    Avoid the friction of siloed, proprietary web apps and sluggish third-party page builders. Trustbadg integrates seamlessly into the native WordPress block editor and admin, offering a fast, lightweight, and distraction-free badge building workflow.
  • True Custom Branding & Domain Authority
    Hosted badge widgets typically force you to embed third-party scripts or iframes on your checkout. Trustbadg renders badges as inline HTML on your own domain, maximizing brand consistency, search-friendly markup, and compatibility with caching plugins.
  • Performance-First Architecture
    Engineered with inline SVG icons, conditional CSS loading, and no frontend JavaScript, Trustbadg keeps checkout pages fast while delivering polished trust badge presentation across all devices. WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility is declared out of the box.

Privacy

Trustbadg does not send site or user data to external servers. No analytics or tracking is included in the free or Pro builds. Geo-targeting in Pro uses server-side headers (such as Cloudflare CF-IPCountry or WooCommerce geolocation) only with no external geo API calls.

Performance

Trustbadg is built for store speed:

  • No frontend JavaScript : badges render as server-side HTML with pure CSS. Bundled icons use inline SVG markup; custom uploads use standard image tags.
  • Conditional assets : public CSS loads only on pages where a badge set block, shortcode, or active automatic placement is expected to render. Developers can override with the trustbadg_enqueue_public_assets filter.
  • Cache-friendly : static HTML output with no cookies, sessions, or frontend AJAX. Fully compatible with full-page caching (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, and similar plugins).
  • WooCommerce HPOS : compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (custom order tables).
  • E-commerce integrations — WooCommerce, EDD, SureCart, FluentCart, MemberPress, RCP, PMPro, and GiveWP placements use standard action hooks only (no direct order table access).
sections.installation:
Quick WordPress Installation

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Trustbadg – Trust Badges, Payment Icons & Secure Checkout Seals.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. Open Trustbadg in the admin sidebar to configure settings and create your first badge set.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin archive and upload the trustbadg-trust-badges folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins management screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Trustbadg → Badge Sets to create a badge set, then insert the Trustbadg block or copy the generated shortcode into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Who is Trustbadg built for?

Trustbadg is built for anyone who wants professional trust badges and payment icons on their own WordPress site — including WooCommerce store owners, digital product sellers, membership sites, donation platforms, freelancers, and agencies managing client storefronts.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads are optional. Checkout-specific placement options appear only when a supported e-commerce plugin is active. You can still use blocks, shortcodes, and site-wide content placements without any e-commerce plugin.

Where are my badge sets stored?

Every badge set you create is saved securely in your WordPress database as a native trustbadg_badge_set custom post type entry. You edit icons, design, and placement settings through the Trustbadg badge set editor — just like managing any standard WordPress content type.

Is custom icon upload available on Free?

Custom icon uploads are a Pro feature (Brand module). The free tier includes the first 501 bundled GPL-compatible SVG icons plus 3 icon mix presets and Custom Mix.

Does Trustbadg require a page builder like Elementor or Divi?

No. Trustbadg is built natively for the WordPress Gutenberg block editor and standard admin screens. It provides a smooth editing experience without bloating your site with heavy third-party page builder assets.

Can I use Trustbadg with full-page caching?

Yes. Trustbadg outputs static server-rendered HTML with no frontend JavaScript, no cookies, and no frontend AJAX. Public CSS loads conditionally only where badges may render, making it compatible with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, and similar caching plugins.

Are geo-targeted payment badges available on Free?

Geo-targeted payment badges and the Targeting & Rules tab are Pro features. Compare free and Pro capabilities under Trustbadg → Billing in the admin.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

By default, all plugin settings, transients, and badge set posts are permanently deleted. Enable Retain data on uninstall under Trustbadg → Settings → Privacy to keep your data in the database when the plugin is removed. Custom icon uploads always remain in the Media Library.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Purchase Pro from the vendor site, deactivate Trustbadg, upload the Pro ZIP using Replace current with uploaded, activate, and enter your license key. Your badge sets and settings are preserved. Compare plans under Trustbadg → Billing before upgrading.
